title: High-throughput mass cytometry staining for deep phenotyping of human natural killer cells
protocol: Prepare 15 mL conical tubes with RPMI 10% Fetal Calf Serum (FCS).
Thaw each sample vial in a 37°C water bath until a small pellet of ice appears.
Transfer the contents of PBMC vial to a 15 mL conical tube and rinse the vial.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard flow-through and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of RPMI 2% FCS.
Add 1 μL of Pierce Universal Nuclease 25 kU and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Filter the cells with a 30 μm filter and proceed to cell count.
Mix 10 μL of cell suspension with 10 μL of trypan blue.
Load this mix onto KOVA slide and count cells.
Centrifuge all samples: 400 × g, 5 min, 20°C–22°C.
Resuspend the pellet in CSM, and distribute 3.106 cells/well up to 250 μL in 96-well polypropylene plates.
Centrifuge the plate: 1,017 × g, 3 min, 20°C–22°C.
Prepare cisplatin working solution.
Add 100 μL / well of cisplatin diluted at final concentration of 1 μM and incubate samples for 5 min at 37°C.
Prepare FcR blocking reagent by diluting Fc Block 1:10 with CSM.
Add 100 μL of diluted FcR blocking reagent to each well, mix by pipetting and incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Add 100 μL of CSM and centrifuge at 1,017 × g, 3 min, 4°C.
Add 25 μL of extracellular master mix per sample and incubate for 1 h at 4°C.
Add 175 μL of CSM and centrifuge at 1,017 × g, 3 min, 4°C.
Aspirate the flow-through.
Wash the cells with 200 μL of CSM.
Centrifuge at 1,017 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the flow-through.
Add 100 μL of formaldehyde 2%.
Incubate for 15 min at 20°C–22°C.
Add 100 μL of CSM.
Centrifuge at 1,017 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the flow-through.
Wash the cells with 200 μL of Foxp3 Staining Buffer Set by diluting Fixation/Permeabilization concentrate in Perm Diluent (1/4 dilution).
Add 25 μL of intracellular master mix per sample.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Add 175 μL of Perm/Wash working solution.
Centrifuge at 1,017 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the flow-through.
Wash the cells with 200 μL of 1× Perm/Wash.
Centrifuge at 1,017 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Prepare a 2% formaldehyde solution by diluting fresh 16% formaldehyde with PBS.
Add 100 μL of 2% PFA + DNA intercalator (Cell-IDTM Intercalator-Ir) diluted at 1:1,000 per sample.
Incubate for 12–16 h.
Wash the cells with 100 μL of CSM and centrifuge at 1,017 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the flow-through and wash the cells with 200 μL of CSM and centrifuge at 1,017 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Add 100 μL of freezing media per sample and store directly in microtunes at -80°C until acquisition.
Thaw samples at 20°C-22°C.
Transfer the cells into a 96-well plate and add 100 μL of PBS.
Centrifuge samples for 3 min at 1,017 × g at 4°C.
Aspirate flow-through by pipette.
Repeat washing steps with PBS.
Add 200 μL of deionized water (DIW) and proceed to cell count.
Centrifuge samples for 3 min at 1,017 × g at 4°C and aspirate the flow-through.
Prepare a stock solution of 1:10 EQ Bead/DIW.
Adjust the concentration by aspirating flow-through and resuspending samples with EQ Bead/DIW to achieve an acquisition rate of 500 events/second (i.e., 1 M/mL).
Normalize and concatenate the files before analysis.
